name: adlytics-frontend
description: Production Next.js static export for governed presentation pages.

scripts.build: next build && node scripts/externalise-inline-scripts.mjs && node scripts/check-export-routes.mjs

//pins.no component library: Deliberate. The production shell uses semantic React components and CSS variables without a runtime UI dependency.
//pins.react-markdown: 10.1.0 with remark-gfm 4.0.1 (owner-approved, ADR-083): renders the streamed Markdown answer as React elements from a syntax tree, so raw HTML is never rendered and the ADR-082 lint rule stays in force. Both are ESM-only and peer on React >=18.
//pins.typescript: 5.9.3 to match infra/, where ts-jest forbids 7.x.
//pins.overrides: @next/eslint-plugin-next's fast-glob 3.3.1 is aliased to tinyglobby 0.2.17, already in the lockfile, so fast-glob, micromatch and braces 3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, no patched release) leave the lockfile (A-CVE-BRACES-DEV-001). The plugin calls it only when ESLint settings.next.rootDir is set, which test/eslint-config.test.ts keeps unset. Drop the alias once a patched braces ships. sharp 0.35.5 (GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w, O-ASH-CVE-SHARP-001) and source-map-js 1.2.2 (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q, O-ASH-CVE-SOURCEMAP-001) are the first patched versions; sharp is next's optional dependency and unused by the unoptimized static export, and source-map-js is build-time CSS tooling. Drop each once every parent's range resolves to a patched version on its own.
//pins.@stryker-mutator/core, @stryker-mutator/: 10.0.0, owner-approved 2026-10-19 for mutation testing (ADR-013); `make mutate` runs them. typed-rest-client 2.3.1 (Stryker's dashboard client, unused here) pins qs 6.15.1 (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g), so qs is lifted to 6.16.0, the first patched release, under it. Drop the override once Stryker depends on a typed-rest-client that resolves a patched qs on its own.
//pins.next: 16.3.8 is the first patched version for GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4 and the five lower-rated advisories against 16.3.6 (O-ASH-CVE-NEXT-001).
//pins.@types/node: 24.x to match the Node 24 LTS target.
//pins.node: Engine pinned to the Node 24 LTS line, enforced by engine-strict in .npmrc so a wrong runtime fails the install rather than warning. 26.x is Current, not LTS, and infra-style-cdk bans targeting it. 20.x is end-of-life.
